import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { matchingItems, sampleItems } from '../src/prototype';

describe('prototype sample', () => {
  it('searches titles and descriptions without case or surrounding-space sensitivity', () => {
    expect(matchingItems(sampleItems(), '  BRIEF ')).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(matchingItems(sampleItems(), 'mobile')[0]?.id).toBe('review');
  });
  it('shows all items for an empty search and none for an unknown term', () => {
    expect(matchingItems(sampleItems(), ' ')).toHaveLength(3);
    expect(matchingItems(sampleItems(), 'unmatched')).toEqual([]);
  });
  it('creates independent sample state for each session', () => {
    const first = sampleItems();
    first[0]!.saved = true;
    expect(sampleItems()[0]?.saved).toBe(false);
  });
});
